title: VeloCloud Fix Demands Management-Plane Proof
caption:
Arista has issued fixes for CVE-2026-16812 in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator. Defenders must verify running builds, restrict management access, and validate administrative integrity to ensure control-plane security.
